profile.headline: Software Engineer @ BlackRock | Forward Deployed & Solutions Engineering | AI Agents, LLM Tooling | Founder
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer at BlackRock, working across platform infrastructure, product engineering, and AI tooling. I graduated from Georgia Tech CS, with concentration in Artificial Intelligence and Human-Computer Interaction. Before this I founded a consumer sports app and raised seed funding.

Most of the work I'm proudest of started with a conversation rather than a ticket — embedding with a team, figuring out what they actually need, then building it. I'm focused on forward deployed and solutions engineering roles where I'm in front of the customer and still writing the code. Always open to connecting.

projects.title: CapGen
projects.description: CapGen uses Google's Cloud Vision API to detect the most important elements of submitted pictures to the app. It then results in an AI generated Instagram caption for that picture.

projects.title: SmartStu
projects.description: The SmartStu lyric generator is intended to inspire ideas and help you, the artist, create a masterpiece using a Markov model. Simply choose a genre and the application will output a seed for your imagination. Try it out at Smartstu.space
